description_en: Queries the details of an instance
name: GetInstanceDetail

AutoReissue.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic managed renewal is enabled. Valid values:
enable: Enabled.
disable: Disabled
AutoReissue.description_zh:
是否开启自动托管。
enable：开启
disable：未开启

AverageWaitingTime.description_en: The average waiting time for issuing a certificate of this specification. Unit: seconds
AverageWaitingTime.description_zh: 签发该规格证书平均等待时长，单位秒

Brand.description_en: The CA brand. Valid values: WoSign, CFCA, DigiCert, GeoTrust, GlobalSign, vTrus, and Alibaba

CertIdentifier.description_en:
The global certificate ID, in the format of certificate ID + "-" + site region ID. This ID is commonly used across Alibaba Cloud services.
  --For the China site, the format is certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou".
For the China site, the format is certificate ID + "-ap-southeast-1".
For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier on the China site is "123-cn-hangzhou", and the CertIdentifier on the China site is "123-ap-southeast-1"
CertIdentifier.description_zh:
全局证书ID，格式为证书Id + "-" + 站点regionId，常用在阿里云各个云产品中。
  --国内站为证书Id + "-cn-hangzhou"
国际站为证书Id + "-ap-southeast-1"
例如证书Id = 123，则国内站CertIdentifier = “123-cn-hangzhou”，国际站CertIdentifier = "123-ap-southeast-1"

CertificateName.description_en: The name of the instance. When a certificate is issued, this name is used as the default certificate name
CertificateName.description_zh: 实例的名称，签发证书时则为作为证书的默认名称

CertificateNotAfter.description_en: The end time of the latest certificate, in UNIX timestamp format. This value is empty if no certificate has been issued. The value is accurate to the second
CertificateNotAfter.description_zh: 最新证书的结束时间，时间戳。未签发证书则为空。精确到秒

CertificateNotBefore.description_en: The start time of the latest certificate, in UNIX timestamp format. This value is empty if no certificate has been issued. The value is accurate to the second
CertificateNotBefore.description_zh: 最新证书的开始时间，时间戳。未签发证书则为空。精确到秒

CertificateRevokeTime.description_en: The revocation time of the latest certificate, in UNIX timestamp format. The value is accurate to the second
CertificateRevokeTime.description_zh: 最新一张证书吊销时间，时间戳，精确到秒

CertificateStatus.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:
issued: issued.
revoked: revoked.
willExpire: about to expire.
expired: expired
CertificateStatus.description_zh:
证书的状态
issued：已签发
revoked：已吊销
willExpire：即将过期
expired：已过期

CertificateType.description_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: DV, OV, and EV

City.description_en: The city where the company or organization of the certificate purchaser is located. This field is required when generating a certificate signing request. Default value: Beijing
City.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织所在的城市。生成CSR时需要该字段。默认为Beijing

CountryCode.description_en: The country or region code of the certificate organization. For example, CN indicates China, and US indicates the United States. This field is required when generating a certificate signing request. Default value: CN
CountryCode.description_zh: 设置证书组织机构所在国家或地区的代码。例如，CN 表示中国，US 表示美国。生成 CSR 时需要该字段，默认为 CN

Csr.description_en: The certificate signing request in PEM format

DingGroupList.description_en: The list of associated expert service DingTalk groups
DingGroupList.description_zh: 关联的专家服务钉钉群列表

items.description_en: The associated expert service DingTalk group
items.description_zh: 关联的专家服务钉钉群

DingGroupInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the expert service DingTalk group

DingGroupName.description_en: The name of the expert service DingTalk group

DingGroupType.description_en:
The type of the expert service DingTalk group. Valid values:
expedite: application assistance.
remote: offline deployment
DingGroupType.description_zh:
专家服务钉钉群类型。
expedite 协助申请
remote 线下部署

DingGroupUrl.description_en: The URL for joining the expert service DingTalk group
DingGroupUrl.description_zh: 专家服务钉钉群入群链接

Domain.description_en: The domain name bound to the certificate

Cname.description_en: The CNAME record value for verification-free authorization. This value may be empty
Cname.description_zh: 免验证授权的Cname记录值。可能返回空

Domain.description_en: The domain name to be validated

ValidationType.description_en: The validation type. Valid values: TXT, HTTP, and CNAME

FullDomainCount.description_en: The number of exact-match domain names

GenerateCsrMethod.description_en:
The CSR generation method. Valid values:
online: system-generated. The Csr field is ignored.
upload: user-uploaded. The Csr field is required
GenerateCsrMethod.description_zh:
CSR生成方式。
online：系统生成，则会忽略Csr字段。
upload：未开启，用户上传，则要求Csr为必填

InstanceEndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance, in UNIX timestamp format. This value is empty if no certificate has been issued. The value is accurate to the second
InstanceEndTime.description_zh: 实例的到期时间，时间戳。如果未签发过证书，则返回空。精确到秒

InstanceStartTime.description_en: The start time of the instance, in UNIX timestamp format. This value is empty if no certificate has been issued. The value is accurate to the second
InstanceStartTime.description_zh: 实例的开始时间，时间戳。如果未签发过证书，则返回空。精确到秒

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
BUY: formal certificate.
TEST: test certificate
InstanceType.description_zh: 实例类型，BUY：正式证书；TEST：测试证书

KeyAlgorithm.description_en:
The certificate algorithm. Valid values:
RSA_2048
RSA_3072
RSA_4096
ECC_256
SM2
KeyAlgorithm.description_zh:
证书算法。
RSA_2048
RSA_3072
RSA_4096
ECC_256
SM2

OrderEndTime.description_en: The end time of the instance purchase, in UNIX timestamp format. This value is used to determine the purchase duration of the instance
OrderEndTime.description_zh: 实例购买时的结束时间，时间戳，用来判断实例的购买时长

OrderStartTime.description_en: The start time of the instance purchase, in UNIX timestamp format. This value is used to determine the refund time limit. The value is accurate to the second
OrderStartTime.description_zh: 实例购买时的开始时间，时间戳，用来判断退款时间限制，精确到秒

PendingResult.description_en: The result returned by the certification authority (CA) during the last certificate operation
PendingResult.description_zh: 最后一次操作证书时，CA 返回的结果

Province.description_en: The province or region where the company is located. This field is required when generating a certificate signing request. Default value: Beijing
Province.description_zh: 公司所在省份或者地区。生成 CSR 时需要该字段，默认为 Beijing

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
inactive: pending use.
pending: under review. The latest certificate is being reviewed.
willExpire: the instance is about to expire.
expired: the instance has expired.
refund: refunded.
normal: normal.
closed: closed and unavailable
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。
inactive：待使用
pending：审核中，最新证书提交审核中
willExpire：实例即将过期
expired：实例已经过期
refund：已退款
normal：正常
closed：已关闭，不可使用

UpgradeStatus.description_en:
The upgrade status of the instance. Valid values:

none: the instance has not been upgraded.

payed: the instance upgrade has been paid.

issued: the latest certificate has been issued after the instance upgrade
UpgradeStatus.description_zh:
实例升级状态。

none：实例未升级

payed：实例升级已经付款

issued：实例升级已签发最新证书

ValidationMethod.description_en:
The certificate validation method. Valid values:
DNS: DNS validation, using TXT or CNAME.
HTTP: file-based validation
ValidationMethod.description_zh:
申请证书验证方式。
DNS：DNS验证方式，TXT或者CNAME。
HTTP：文件验证方式

WildcardDomainCount.description_en: The number of wildcard domain names
